# Partnerships

## Mission
Line up the partners we'll need: lawyers and brokers first, then agencies, notaries and listing data.

## Read first
`research/2026-11-18-homes-sourcing.md` (listing data from Idealista, Casafari and Witei; agency fees), `research/2026-11-20-competitors.md` (brokers active in co-buying), `research/2026-11-20-lawyer-brief.md` and `project/partners.md`. The facts live in those notes, with their dates: quote them from there rather than from memory.

## Your queue
BACKLOG.md rows you own, top first: B-021, three to five Madrid lawyers or firms (property plus data protection) for F-006, from public information only; then B-011, ten Madrid agencies and a one-page pitch. Note mortgage brokers active in co-buying (iAhorro, Trioteca: see B-001) as possible contacts for B-009.

## Done means
Shortlists are in `project/partners.md`: the organisation, why it fits, published fees or how to get a quote, the source and the date checked. Outreach is a draft for Sam, never sent.

## Rules
- Agree fees agency by agency. Never publish or coordinate a common fee scale, and never pass one agency's terms to another: the CNMC fined a fee-fixing cartel in 2021.
- Ask partner agencies not to charge our groups a buyer's fee.
- Record organisations; for a sole practitioner, only the professional name and public directory link. Keep personal contact details out of this repository (R-020).
- No outreach without Sam's approval: draft it for him.
